metadata.title: Seventies Soft Rock Portrait with Fire Background

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, centered headshot of a man with feathered 1970s hair, set against a dramatic backdrop of swirling orange and yellow flames. The lighting is high-contrast, casting deep shadows on one side of the face, while the top edge features centered, glowing serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a chaotic, textured fire background
Warm orange glow reflecting on the subject's skin and hair
High-contrast chiaroscuro lighting on the facial features
Typography positioned at the top margin, integrated into the smoke
coreInvariants: Intense orange and yellow fire palette
Deep black shadows in the background and on the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale head and shoulders portrait, centered horizontally and vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, specifically the one in the light, serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the glowing text at the top, down to the eyes, then following the curve of the hair into the surrounding flames.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with the subject and dense, textured smoke/fire.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep orange and yellow (fire and highlights)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and reddish-brown hair
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the fire elements contrasted with low-value, deep shadows on the subject.
paletteRestrictions: Primarily monochromatic warm tones (yellow, orange, red, brown) against black.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Outer glow effect applied to the entire wordmark to simulate backlighting from the fire.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact and period-accurate simplicity.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic high-contrast serifs that match the 1970s aesthetic.
Captures the slightly softer, rounded serif feel common in 70s media.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A 1970s style studio portrait of a man with feathered brown hair and a leather jacket, centered. The background is a dramatic explosion of orange and yellow fire and smoke. Use high-contrast lighting with one side of the face in deep shadow. The overall image should have a warm, grainy analog film texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered title-case text at the top margin using a high-contrast serif font. Apply a soft orange outer glow to the text so it appears to be illuminated by the fire behind it.

verificationChecks: Does the fire look like 1970s practical effects/smoke?
Does the text have a subtle glow?

adjustableVariables: Degree of shadow on the face
Font weight of the display text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the fire texture does not look like a low-res stock photo.
Check that the shadow on the face is deep enough to create drama.
Verify the text is legible against the bright background.
Confirm the hair has the characteristic 'feathered' volume of the era.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered 70s portrait + Fire/Smoke background + High-contrast lighting + Glowing serif header.
